LiftCurvesResultRow.description:
Represents the columns of a row in a lift curves export.

These fields are the current agreed upon standard result. Changes to the fields or
their validation should cause the version defined in the standard result schema to
increase the version number in a way that corresponds to the schema versioning
specification (i.e. they are a patch, minor, or major change).

ALQ.description: Artificial lift quantity axis value. Optional.
ALQ.title: Alq

ALQ_TYPE.description: Index column. The artificial-lift quantity type. Optional.
ALQ_TYPE.title: Alq Type

GFR_TYPE.description: Index column. The gas-fraction type. Optional.
GFR_TYPE.title: Gfr Type

PRESSURE_TYPE.description: Index column. The pressure type. Required.
PRESSURE_TYPE.title: Pressure Type

RATE_TYPE.description: Index column. The flow-rate type. Required.
RATE_TYPE.title: Rate Type

TABLE_NUMBER.description: Index column. The VFP table number. Required.
TABLE_NUMBER.title: Table Number

TAB_TYPE.description: Index column. The tabulated pressure type. Optional.
TAB_TYPE.title: Tab Type

UNIT_TYPE.description: Index column. The unit system. Required.
UNIT_TYPE.title: Unit Type

VFP_TYPE.description: Index column. The VFP table type. Required.
VFP_TYPE.title: Vfp Type

WFR_TYPE.description: Index column. The water-fraction type. Optional.
WFR_TYPE.title: Wfr Type

LiftCurvesResultRow.title: LiftCurvesResultRow

description:
Represents the resultant lift curves parquet file, which is
naturally a list of rows.

Consumers who retrieve this parquet file must read it into a json-dictionary
equivalent format to validate it against the schema.
title: LiftCurvesResult
